'''2009 Bespin Regionals Ross Tennison LS Watch Your Step (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Ross Tennison]] at [[2009 Bespin Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Watch Your Step (V) / This Place Can Be A Little Rough (V) (Virtual Set 9: Sanctuary Moon)|OVS9-24-Watch_Your_Step-remaster.webp|label=Watch Your Step (V) / This Place Can Be A Little Rough (V)}}
* '''Deck name:''' WYS V
* '''Username:''' Makeshift-Grain
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
